source: Census TIGER/Line 2026 congressional districts (cd120) intersected with TIGER/Line 2026 counties; tiny pieces checked against the staged results files in results/
method: A piece of at least 2 km2 is real. A smaller piece is kept when the district's staged results file lists the county, dropped when it does not, and kept with check: true when there is no complete file to ask. Pieces and shares are measured on land (the wall's 500k shoreline), not water and not population.
